EditorMetadata.Description: Slice 1 proof: blueprint-authored rebuild of the C# oracle Condition_HasTarget (HillAttackTankNodes.cs ~line 113) -- an AiPrimitive BTreeCondition. Graph: EventEntry -> GetVariable(TargetNetworkId) -> FunctionCall HillAssault2TankOps.HasTarget(targetNetworkId, self, view) [P7: self/view auto-appended, hidden from pins] -> Branch -> Return(Success)/Return(Failure). DEVIATION 1 (loud, see migration report FRICTION): TargetNetworkId is declared under WorkingState, NOT Parameters, even though the task's design calls for a Param. Confirmed root cause: GetVariable-node pin/IR resolution (Stage0_Rehydrate.ResolveVariableTypeId, Stage5_Schedule.FindVariableIndex/EmissionContext.VarFieldName) only ever consults asset.Variables/asset.WorkingState, never asset.Parameters -- IrOp_ReadParam exists in the IR model and is handled by StatementEmitter but is never PRODUCED by Stage5, i.e. there is currently no node/wiring path that reads an AiPrimitive Parameter into a graph. Verified empirically: pointing GetVariable.VariableId at a Parameter's Guid types its Value pin System.Object (wrong) and would emit 'ws.__var_0' (does not compile) when Variables/WorkingState are otherwise empty. WorkingState is read/write-correct for this exact pattern and is used here only to keep the slice's P7 proof unblocked -- Parameters remains deliberately empty. FORMER DEVIATION 2 (P7.1 FIX, see GAP-9): this asset previously had to live under Recipes/Blueprints/ (not wired into the real Hrot.AI.Behaviors AdditionalFiles/Roslyn-incremental-generator build) because Stage0_Rehydrate.ResolveMethod / Stage5_Schedule.ResolveClrMethodForContext resolve a FunctionCall's target method via runtime System.Reflection INSIDE the Roslyn incremental-generator's own netstandard2.0 analyzer process, which never has Hrot.AI.Behaviors.dll (or any other game assembly) loaded -- silently dropping self/view and producing CS7036. P7.1 fixes this by baking the trailing-context decision into this node's JSON at author time (see the FunctionCall node's "TrailingContext": "SelfAndView" field and its populated "Pins" array, which already excludes self/view) so Stage5_Schedule honors the baked flag directly with NO reflection at generation time. This asset now lives under Assets/Blueprints/ and compiles through the REAL MSBuild/dotnet-build generator path -- see HillAssault2_HasTarget_ProofTests.cs, which now reflects the real generated Hrot.AI.Behaviors.Generated.HillAssault2HasTarget_*_Bp type out of the built Hrot.AI.Behaviors.dll (mirroring HillAssault2_AbortEngagement_ProofTests) instead of the in-process BlueprintCompiler.Compile workaround. Does not modify the C# oracle.
